notes: New Settings → Important Settings → Network & Login. 1) '🔓 Allow office PCs on this network' (main PC): adds a Windows Firewall rule for Mineral Saathi on every network type, also Public, but only for PCs of the same office network — no need to change the network to Private (Windows asks 'Yes' once). 2) Login: make users (ID, name, password) and tick 'Other PCs must log in'. Other PCs then see a login page and stay logged in for 30 days; the main PC never asks. Log out at the bottom left. Setup-Main-PC.bat now makes the same firewall rule.
